findings.claim: Inverted guard: the last TypeCollector hunk uses `if (stringMembers.ContainsKey(member.StringKey))` where the matching hunks use `!`. A string key is never in the empty dictionary on first sight, so no string-keyed member from this second member loop (the field pass, mirroring the property pass at line 1005) is ever added to `stringMembers`. With SuppressSourceGeneration unset, the generated map-mode formatter silently drops those members, which is data loss on serialization. This contradicts 'Behaviour with SuppressSourceGeneration unset or false does not change'. For suppressed types, those members also escape member-level checks such as MsgPack003.
